label: C2 contingency grounding: laws, rival models and omission models
paraphrase: Premise-free laws and finite Bool models (structural surrogates, not metaphysical possibility). Laws: C2 implies its weak form; the weak form with B3 implies C2; R1 with De ente's receiver reading implies C2; B2 with B3 implies C2; correlation implies #1870's bridge (ii) restricted to beings incorruptible simply; PGP with no power of anything over its own esse and corruptible-has-POTENCY_1 gives q.9 a.2's MUTABLE_3 for every contingent being (bridge (i)); the PGP route reaches the First Way endpoint; B4b implies corruptible-has-POTENCY_1; B4a implies PGP; with the adopted POTENCY_1 and the existence-to-act interface, B4b excludes every actual being corruptible simply at w, so corruptibility is not POTENCY_1 at esse. Models: bruteSimple (a contingent, simple, unreceived, uncaused, incorruptible first mover under no power: every premise of the PGP and C2 routes holds except PGP and C2; CCR holds on the same frame's q.3 a.4 profile with that being uncaused); selfAnnihilator (PGP holds; correlation fails, or no-self-esse-cause fails in the self-causing variant); uncausedComposite (C2 holds by reception while PGP, B2 and C2's prior-cause disjunct fail); angelic (a contingent POTENCY_1-pure-act incorruptible being under a necessary prior source: everything holds, B4 and the pure-act target fail); deistSource (PGP and C2 hold, correlation and B2 or B4 fail, so C2 does not entail B2 or B4); bareCorruptible, selfAnnihilator and unprioritizedSource as omission models of passive-to-receptive, correlation, no-self-esse-cause and B3; witness (every premise of every new argument, applied nonvacuously); potencyOnly (the pure-act target, B4 and B2 or B4 hold, PGP and C2 fail, so C2 and B2 or B4 are independent); corruptor (correlation and C2 hold through matter and form while R1 fails, so C2 does not require R1; the unrestricted bridge (ii) fails).
